title: Building reliable agentic AI systems
summary: This Martin Fowler article provides architectural guidance on building reliable, production-ready agentic AI systems, covering key challenges like unpredictability, state management, and error handling in LLM-based applications.
problem_solved: Addresses the fundamental challenge of making non-deterministic AI agent systems reliable enough for production enterprise deployments.
why_valuable: Provides battle-tested architectural patterns from Martin Fowler's signature style, offering practical solutions for one of the most pressing challenges in modern AI engineering.
